title: Users can frontrun rebase to extract profits at the expense of long-term stakers
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `StakingToken` contract is susceptible to a frontrunning attack during the rebase process. Users who monitor on-chain events can detect when a rebase is imminent, especially if they can predict or observe an increase in the total supply in the calldata.
